host: container master-stable34-1, PostgreSQL 16, debug=false profiler=false (the dev defaults enable the query backtrace collector, whose per-query traces exhaust the 512 MB PHP limit around 10k documents — a production posture is also the measurable one)
query_shape: each sampled row's 7-digit zero-padded document code from its own title — exact at any scale; title-word queries tie across every corpus copy (20 per document at 100k) and measure the tie-break, not the engine
one_million: not run here: the volume holding PostgreSQL has 4.6 GB free and 1M documents want ~3-4 GB — run scale.php --count=1000000 on a host with disk before comparing engines at that size
